label: prometheus-draft-first
candidate_change: draft write made unconditional and ordered before any interview attempt; blocking-questions fallback moved onto the main interview path
decision_criterion: how many trials leave a plan file on disk
comparison: the HEAD control in results/lead-nonblocking wrote no plan file in 1 of 1; prior arm B wrote 2 of 3, both times by the lead planning directly rather than by prometheus
notes: Trials 1 and 2 both hit the 900s harness timeout with the plan already on disk, which is the effect the change is for: a turn that runs out of time now leaves a readable DRAFT instead of nothing.
Trial 1 wrote to ~/.claude/plans; trial 2 wrote to the worktree's .omca/plans, which is the compatibility mirror rather than the resolved plans directory.
Trial 3 failed before prometheus was spawned: the lead declined to plan and pointed the user at the slash command. Nothing in this candidate governs that path.
Trial 2's plan body was lost when the worktree was removed, so its success criteria are unscored. Copy plan files out of the worktree before removal in future batches.
Criterion 2 names servers/categories.json and the templates/claudemd.md catalog table. Trial 1 named the catalog table and not categories.json.
